_설명: 천일문 2권 Chapter 05 to부정사 가운데 명사적·형용사적·부사적 용법 문항을 변형한 것. 은행에서는 기본 3과 부정사[1] 자리에 합쳐 둔다.

questions.prompt: 다음 중 <보기>의 밑줄 친 부분과 어법상 쓰임이 같은 것을 고르세요.
body: <보기> [[It]] is fun to play board games with friends.

choices.text: It is 8 o’clock right now.
It is not my fault at all.
It is very close to my house.
It is my favorite writer’s novel.
It is hard to answer his question.

questions.prompt: 다음 중 밑줄 친 부분의 쓰임이 다른 하나를 고르세요.

choices.text: She planned [[to move]] to a smaller house next year.
Tony needs a hat [[to wear]] for the trip.
My dream is [[to become]] a vet like my aunt.
[[To learn]] a new language takes a long time.
Kelly chose [[to study]] abroad with her brother.

questions.prompt: 다음 중 밑줄 친 부분의 쓰임이 다른 하나를 고르세요.

choices.text: The library is far [[to walk]] from here.
[[To catch]] the first train, she woke up early.
He was glad [[to win]] the prize.
She promised [[to write]] 5 letters this month.
The nurse went to Nepal [[to help]] sick children.

questions.prompt: 다음 중 (A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것을 고르세요.
body: To check your bag before a trip is helpful.
= ______(A) is helpful ______(B) your bag before a trip.

choices.text: It — checking
It — to check
It — to checking
That — checking
That — to check

questions.prompt: 다음 중 (A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것을 고르세요.
body: • He has no partner to play ______(A) at the club.
• Do you have one more cushion to sit ______(B)?

choices.text: with — at
with — on
for — to
for — in
on — in

questions.prompt: 우리말과 일치하도록 주어진 단어를 올바르게 배열하세요.
body: 그 물은 마시기에 안전하다. (is / drink / safe / to / the water)
questions.answer: The water is safe to drink

questions.prompt: 다음 두 문장을 to부정사를 사용하여 한 문장으로 완성하세요.
body: Mia has three shirts. She has to iron them.

questions.prompt: 다음 두 문장을 to부정사를 사용하여 한 문장으로 완성하세요.
body: Tom wanted to buy some fruit. He went to the market.
questions.answer: to the market to buy some fruit

questions.prompt: 다음 중 어법상 알맞지 않은 문장을 고르세요.

choices.text: It’s time to do your science homework.
Sumi really needs someone to talk to.
It’s the best way solve this problem.
Is there anything to eat in the fridge?

questions.prompt: 다음 중 <보기>의 밑줄 친 부분과 어법상 쓰임이 같은 것을 모두 고르세요.
body: <보기> My friend Ken in Canada will visit Korea [[to meet]] me. I decided to let Ken stay at my house for a week.

choices.text: I was happy to get the letter.
We were pleased to meet many guests.
